runs.t: Prefabricated concrete structural products engineered and manufactured to exacting standards — creating highly efficient, durable, and resilient structures across every building type.
Precast construction ensures structural resilience and adaptability to meet escalating data center demands — with factory-controlled production for schedule certainty.
Clark Pacific designs, manufactures, and builds the complete parking structure — delivering a high quality, on-time, on-budget facility with single-source accountability.
A high-performing building system, reimagined from the ground up — combining design flexibility with offsite construction while prioritizing energy efficiency, sustainability, and occupant wellness.
Leverage our structural building platform, which delivers specific performance requirements such as optimal vibration control and design flexibility for a range of lab and research applications.

From office buildings and data centers to student housing, prefabricated building systems are designed to enhance occupant comfort. Superior thermal performance, abundant natural daylight, and flexible, open spaces create environments that support productivity and well-being.
Prefabricated concrete structures provide superior resistance to fire and natural disasters, providing a long service life due to their durable, low-maintenance materials.
Concrete's density helps buildings absorb and isolate sound — making precast an ideal choice for commercial offices, labs, and healthcare environments.

The City of Roseville is extremely pleased with the project outcome. Publicly-funded projects of this size, scope and complexity are rarely, if ever, completed in the timeframe of 316 Vernon, due in significant part to the precast design and innovative just-in-time construction methods. Other added benefits from an operational perspective include lower long-term maintenance costs, superior sound isolation/exterior noise suppression, and approximately 30% less energy consumption attributable to heating and cooling as a result of the building’s efficient thermal mass. What are Clark Pacific Structural Solutions?

Clark Pacific Structural Solutions are prefabricated concrete building systems engineered and manufactured to exacting standards. When combined, they create efficient, durable, resilient structures supporting offices, data centers, parking structures, labs, and other building types.
